name: 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde
description: 4-Hydroxybenzaldehyde (CAS 123-08-0 ), commonly referred to as 4-HBA or p-hydroxybenzaldehyde, is a phenolic aldehyde used as a key synthetic intermediate and flavoring agent across pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetic manufacturing. FEMA 3984 status supports its use in flavor applications where regulatory traceability is required. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, 4-HBA serves as a precursor in the synthesis of active ingredients. It is used in the production of antiviral compounds and vanillin derivatives, making it a recurring procurement target for API producers. Food and beverage formulators source it as a flavoring component. Its natural phenolic character contributes to vanilla-adjacent profiles in various food products. In personal care, it functions as a UV stabilizer and preservative booster in skin and hair formulations. Polymer and resin producers also use it as a building block for UV-stabilizing additives and specialty antioxidant systems. 4-Hydroxybenzaldehyde is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline solid. Standard commercial grades include technical and pharmaceutical-grade material, with high-purity specifications available to meet API intermediate requirements. FCC -grade material is available for flavor applications. This grade is essential for food applications requiring documented food safety compliance.
